$docs: Committed template — NO real keys. Copy to secrets.develop.json (local dev) or use secrets.production.example.json as a guide for production env vars / secrets.production.json mount.
$setup: Copy-Item secrets.example.json secrets.develop.json  →  fill values  →  dotnet run --project backend/src/Vni.Ielts.Api

Jwt.$SigningKey: Optional in dev (auto-generated if empty). Required in production — min 32 chars. Env: Jwt__SigningKey

Ai.$AllowCrossBorderTransfer: true only after PDPL/B-2 decision. Env: Ai__AllowCrossBorderTransfer

OpenAi.$BaseUrl: Empty = official OpenAI. Reseller hosts currently allowlisted: api.vietapi.tech, apithat.dev. Env: Ai__OpenAi__BaseUrl
OpenAi.$SyntheticDataOnly: true blocks learner essays on third-party BaseUrl. Env: Ai__OpenAi__SyntheticDataOnly

Parser.$doc: The AI-assisted parser for raw exam source documents (docx/pdf/txt). Empty by default: the door stays shut and every raw upload fails with AI_PARSER_UNAVAILABLE (UnconfiguredExamSourceParser) until Provider and Model are BOTH filled AND Ai:OpenAi:ApiKey (above) is set — a section naming only some of that refuses to boot rather than failing on the first upload. Provider selects which Ai:<Provider> section supplies the key; it does NOT hold its own ApiKey — one credential, one place to rotate it. Env: Import__Parser__Provider / __Model / __BaseUrl

Transcription.$doc: Turns a Listening recording inside an uploaded package into text at import time, so the deterministic answer-anchor check has something to search (0 of 24 Listening parts in this repository's Cambridge packages carry a transcript). A transcript already in the package always wins and no model is called (IP-08). Empty by default: UnconfiguredAudioTranscriber is wired and the stage leaves every package untouched, until Provider and Model are BOTH filled AND Ai:OpenAi:ApiKey (above) is set — a section naming only some of that refuses to boot. Provider selects which Ai:<Provider> section supplies the key; it does NOT hold its own ApiKey. NOT Speaking marking: transcribing a learner's own recording is deferred by P-02 and lives on a different port (ITranscriptSource/NoTranscriptSource), untouched. Env: Import__Transcription__Provider / __Model / __BaseUrl

Google.$ClientId: Google Cloud OAuth WEB client. Env: Sso__Google__ClientId

Email.$Host: Empty = no SMTP (dev OK). Env: Email__Host

ObjectStorage.$ServiceUrl: MinIO local or R2/S3 endpoint. Env: ObjectStorage__ServiceUrl
ObjectStorage.$layout: Default: one bucket per retention class, prefixes empty. Alternative (ADR-0016, owner decision 2026-09-04): one bucket for all three with a distinct folder each — set the three *Prefix keys (e.g. examassets/, dictation/, speakingrecord/); the startup gate refuses shared buckets whose prefixes overlap, and the shared bucket must not be versioned.
